thread:
ivan: seeing 503s from the gateway in west3, authz returning 429s. provisioning churn and GPU nodes cycling. anyone on this? /cc @sre-oncall
maya: yep, saw spikes. logs showing repeated token fetch retries: `authz: rate_limit_exceeded user=svc-provisioner`
sre-oncall: investigating now, paging infra team.
ops-bot: incident INC-3812 created, priority=P1. linked runbook: runbooks/gateway-authz-throttle.
infra-bot: alert: control-plane authz QPS 12k -> 52k in 5m window.
kyle: edge still directs most traffic to west3. should we shift to na-east1 to reduce pressure? cost hit but quick mitigation.
anya: agree to a gradual shift. propose 20% -> 50% over 15m. I'll prepare route update. also suggest bumping provisioner retry interval to 10s to reduce token storm.
ivan: careful with cache warmups on other regions — may spike downstream during warm starts.
maya: quick snippet from provisioner logs: `provisioner: allocation_failed reason=quota_exceeded GPUs=8 attempt=3`
sre-oncall: looks like a rollout regression in 2.14.1 changed authz retry/backoff. can we pin back canary?
kyle: we can pin serving to 2.13.9 in west3 to stop new clients from using 2.14.1 behaviors. rollback candidate ready.
anya: applying route change now: `curl -XPOST https://routeapi.internal/v1/shift -d '{"region":"na-east1","percent":20}'`
ops-bot: route update applied. traffic shift 0% -> 20% to na-east1.
maya: after initial 20% shift authz QPS dropped ~35%, provisioner backlog down 120 -> 45. errors reduced but console auth still intermittent.
ivan: console auth errors: `token_verify_failed admin_user=alice error=429`. admins hitting rate limiter.
sre-oncall: temp mitigation: enable kv-token-cache fallback for console auth endpoints to avoid fresh token exchange. patching now.
deploy-bot: patch rollout started: west3-console-patch -> hosts (3/6).
anya: disabling auto-evac on provisioner in west3 to avoid thrashing while we stabilize.
kyle: cost FYI — if we move to 50% to na-east1, GPU hourly spend estimated +60%. approve for 2 hours?
maya: approve for 2 hours to buy time, monitor closely.
ivan: add ephemeral label `incident/2165001234` to traces and logs so postmortem can filter.
sre-oncall: assigning postmortem owner: maya. will collect traces, metric deltas, and rollout diffs.
maya: will open the postmortem doc and link runbook gaps. initial summary to execs in 1.5h.
ops-bot: incident status -> mitigated (partial). console auth degraded for subset of customers; serving restored via routing shift and rollback pin. next update in 30m. :thumbsup:
